description: Searches Italian municipalities (comuni) by name, tolerating typos and most partial names, and returns each match with its 6-digit ISTAT code, province and region. Use it when you have a place name and need the code; do not use it once you have the code (use leggi_dati_comune instead) or to list the comuni of a province (use elenca_territori instead). Matching is by similarity, so homonyms come back too, most similar first, up to `limite`. `provincia` and `regione` filter before `limite` applies, so a homonym beyond the cut is still found; given together, both must hold. An empty list is not an error: nothing resembles the name, or the filters removed every match (see `nota`). Public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

nome.description: Name of the comune, full or partial, 2-80 characters, in any case; typos, missing accents and apostrophes are tolerated ("cassano adda" finds Cassano d'Adda), and the English names of the main cities ("Florence", "Venice") find the comune first.

provincia.description: Italian name of a province, in any case ("Trento", "Bolzano", "Monza e Brianza").

regione.description: Italian name of a region, in any case ("Toscana"; Bolzano and Trento are in "Trentino-Alto Adige").

name: cerca_comune

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

nota.description: Set only when `provincia` or `regione` excluded every match: how many comuni with a similar name exist elsewhere. Null otherwise.

risultati.description: Matching comuni, most similar name first, at most `limite`; empty when nothing resembles the text.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code, as a string with leading zeros kept: the `cod_istat` input of leggi_dati_comune.

provincia.description: Province (or metropolitan city) as recorded by ISTAT; null if not recorded.

regione.description: Region as recorded by ISTAT (Bolzano and Trento are provinces of TRENTINO-ALTO ADIGE); null if not recorded.

title: Search Italian comuni by name
